capabilities: Restore cursor, scroll, and selection per note
Save positions to a configurable JSON file
Exclude files and folders from tracking
Restore positions when loading a workspace
Prune stale or excess saved positions
extras: README documents detailed settings (save delay, default position when none saved, database pruning by age, count, or deleted files) and install steps but no screenshots or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian does not remember where you were in a note, so returning to a long document means manually scrolling to find your place.
summary: Remember cursor position that restores each note's cursor, scroll position, and text selection when you reopen it, even after restarting Obsidian.
